title: Pay $10 to be human
description: Prove your humanity by surviving a checkout with ten imaginary dollars, an inconvenience fee, and an upgrade nobody asked for. Play money only. Real charge: $0.

concept.action: Negotiate who pays a checkout fee, then authorize ten dollars in play money.
concept.sequence: Choose a fee payer, try to fit the imaginary wallet, consider Premium Human, review the receipt, and authorize the imaginary payment.
concept.difficulty: The proof consumes your entire imaginary wallet. Fees and premium humanity put you over budget, so you must negotiate and remove extras.
concept.success: Authorize a reviewed total of exactly 1,000 imaginary cents. A receipt proves humanity through checkout suffering. No real payment occurs.
